0022600216.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder (8-2, 1st in the Northwest, W4) head to the Portland Trail Blazers (6-2, 2nd in the Northwest, L1) for the 11th game of the Thunder's season, with Oklahoma City 5-0 at home and 3-2 on the road. Oklahoma City is missing Cason Wallace (shoulder, surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg, fracture), Jaylin Williams (back, spasms), and Thomas Sorber (knee), while Portland is without Ja Morant (hamstring), Robert Williams III (rest), Shaedon Sharpe (knee, surgery), and Vit Krejci (ankle). The teams have not played each other yet in the 2026-27 season, and the Thunder won the 2025-26 series 3-1, including a 124-95 victory in Oklahoma City on December 31, 2025.
